name: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria
authority: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
description: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria provides a framework for evaluating an organization's controls relevant to Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy. The 2017 criteria align with COSO 2013.

domains.name: Common Criteria
domains.description: Common criteria related to security that apply across all trust services categories

domains.name: Availability
domains.description: Criteria for systems available for operation and use as committed or agreed

domains.name: Processing Integrity
domains.description: Criteria for system processing that is complete, valid, accurate, timely, and authorized

domains.name: Confidentiality
domains.description: Criteria for information designated as confidential is protected as committed or agreed

domains.name: Privacy
domains.description: Criteria for personal information collected, used, retained, disclosed, and disposed

metadata.notes: Common Criteria (CC) apply to all engagements; other categories are optional based on scope
